title: Add failure detection to PlaceBlockGoal.HasFailed (P1 audit)
description: P1 finding from 2026-07-11 audit: PlaceBlockGoal.HasFailed always returns false — no failure detection mechanism. If placement is obstructed forever, the goal never fails, creating an infinite loop. Add consecutive-failure detection to HasFailed.
